Bablli ❤️

So… you finally reached the last step. 😌
And honestly, this last one isn't a task.

There's just something I wanted to tell you.

I don't really know what name to give whatever we have between us. Maybe we don't even need one right now.

But somewhere along the way, talking to you became one of those little things I genuinely look forward to.

The random conversations, laughing over stupid things, irritating each other for absolutely no reason 😂, and then those moments when even a simple conversation somehow becomes a good memory.

And yes… sometimes I annoy you with silly things and somehow manage to get that “Maridebi re pua” reaction 😭😂.

But honestly, I like the way you talk to me, the time you give me, and how naturally our conversations keep going. Even that one conversation that somehow turned into almost three hours of talking about our families… I still remember that.

Maybe it's just a collection of small moments. Maybe it's something that will find its own name someday. For now, I'm just happy that I got to know this version of you.

So on your birthday, I just want you to know that you are genuinely special to me.

Keep laughing, keep talking too much, keep saying “udi baba” when I irritate you… and please don't change the little things that make you, you. ❤️

Happy Birthday, Bablli. I hope this year gives you a lot of reasons to smile.

With lots of warmth ❤️
